## **STRATEGY FOR EDGEWARE TREASURY DIVERSIFICATION**

**	**In this article we have demonstrated the results of the** Portfolio Risk Reward Analysis Financial Model**. We (EDG DAO Financial Strategist Team) had also presented this model in the EDG Financial calls which were held on 14/12/21 and 21/12/21.
	The purpose of these models was to prepare an experimental strategy to diversify the Market Maker(Efficient Frontiers) profits(maybe in the future as well) into multiple assets with an aim to attain a balance between the risk and rewards generated by these investments. A similar approach can be used to diversify a part of the community owned Edgeware treasury to hold various tokens/assets which can be useful during market crashes as well to incentivise contributors who contribute in various ways towards the betterment of the community.
	Coming to the actual model, we have prepared **3 models (low risk, high risk, combined)** consisting of a basket of tokens which fall under various categories (blue chip cryptos, stable coins, non-stable etc) based on their past performance. The data we used for these models is from Jan 2020 to Dec 2021 (based on when these coins came into existence) so as to get a mix of up-trends as well as the downtrends in the cryptocurrency markets. Also, we have taken the monthly averages of the prices for each token and their corresponding % changes. For these particular models we have considered **BTC, ETH, RAI and USDT** in the low risk category. This is because, as we know, BTC and ETH are considered to be one of the front-runners in the crypto environment and RAI(algorithmic stable coin) and USDT are also stable tokens. Then we have** DOT, KSM, BNB and ATOM** in the high risk category, as they are relatively more volatile as compared to the blue chip tokens. And finally we merged the tokens in both these models to form a combined model which gives us the option to choose an optimal division of funds to be invested in low risk and high risk portfolios respectively.
	The tokens we have considered in these models are based on our intuition and market knowledge but** we would really love to take suggestions from the community regarding the tokens to be considered in each of the categories for the future models. **

**PS: The actual models are provided in the link below.**

**![](https://lh4.googleusercontent.com/S1MFM58oxQdl9QmlLr9Z1izPEcBRNKOj6P_-M1Kv_JzZrApsvLuEB-GYCVhqywcMHTPmuzCAHy-yZxZpOx2hS7qXfJQdwtH0u-CKF7b6426Igv1bP_vwEtYFwvUJ365tW56oN8as)**

**(** the figures mentioned in this report are our personal opinions, so please don’t consider this as an investment advice)**

- In the initial part of the fortnight the price was on a downward curve, with the volumes traded also being relatively low, and a trend reversal was expected.
- The trading volume was substantially high between 18/11/21 and 19/11/21, also the price showed a steep rise on the corresponding days, so it suggests a very bullish period.
- From 20/11/21 onwards, the volume traded as well as the price corrected significantly.
- From 22/11/21 onwards, till 26/11/21 the price of EDG was constantly decreasing and on 27/11/21 a significant dip in price as well as volume traded was seen. After this, the price has been moving sideways and the volumes are also significantly low.
- Now based on the data below and historical trends, another spike in prices and a trend reversal i.e. positive returns for the next period are around the corner.
